name: PVE Laptop Battery Shutdown
description: Battery monitoring for Proxmox VE on laptop hardware, with compact status logs and estimated runtime. A systemd timer checks battery and AC status and triggers graceful host shutdown after consecutive low-battery readings while external power is disconnected.

notes.text: Run in the Proxmox host shell. Set DRY_RUN=1 in /etc/default/pve-battery-monitor before testing shutdown behavior.
A 10% threshold may be suitable for a healthy battery, but 25% or higher may be safer for older batteries or batteries with unstable low-end reporting
For unattended recovery after shutdown, enable BIOS or UEFI auto power-on on AC restore or a scheduled RTC wake or power-on alarm
